d:
Chhath puja 2026 se pahle dilli ki yamuna ki Ground Reality aakhir kya hai?
Is Ground Report men dekhie Yamuna River Pollution, Chhath Ghat ki taiyariyan aur yamuna ki saphaee ke davon ke bich ki jamini hakikta.
Ek taraph chhath ki aastha, dusri taraph yamuna ki badhal halta. ghat ko sajane vale 25 bachchon ki mehnat se lekar nadi ko ganda karne valon ki kartut tak, dilli ki yamuna se juri kaee anakhi tasviren is riport men samne aaee hain.
Kya yamuna ki saphaee ke dave aur Ground Reality men koee antar hai? dekhie Khabargaon ki yah khas Delhi Yamuna Ground Report.
